expo.name: Bink Admin
expo._comment_typedRoutes: Off for the admin console on purpose. It has a single route, so typed routes add nothing, and shared components (web header, search bar) legitimately link to public-app routes such as /search and /auth. Those are handled at runtime by openPublicRoute, which sends them to EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL instead of routing in-app. The public app keeps typedRoutes on.
